item.title: 🟠 Hackers exploit Cisco SD-WAN flaw to deploy custom KeyDrift malware
item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Adobe Fixes 8 Critical Campaign Classic Flaws Allowing Code Execution and Security Bypass
item.description:
